title: Fusion Light
next_chapter_hook: When the Fusion Light dissipated, a flicker of unprecedented hesitation—perhaps, also another possibility—appeared in the demonic path commander-in-chief's eyes.

text.content: The moment the blood seal shattered, Chen Ji's consciousness was swept into an endless abyss by a vast power. He witnessed the truth of ten thousand years flash before him like a passing parade—Cang Yutian used himself as bait, eternally sealing the existence capable of overturning the Heavenly Dao within the chaos. "So... from the beginning, he wasn't pursuing power, but preventing disaster." Chen Ji murmured, an indescribable shock surging in his chest.

dialogue.content: "You've seen it." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rang in the depths of his consciousness, "But this is only the surface of the truth. Keep watching, Chen Ji—you need to see everything."

text.content: Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt his soul being torn apart by two diametrically opposite forces. One was cold as abyssal spring water, the other scorching like divine fire from the Nine Heavens. He suddenly realized—that was the Twin Stars' last will remaining in the world, attempting to fuse with him. "No... this is a trap!" He wanted to break free, only to find his body already beyond control.

The fusion process was agonizingly painful. Chen Ji felt himself being infinitely stretched, every memory dismantled into its most basic particles. However, just as his consciousness was about to dissipate, he saw it—the complete vision of the Fourth Ending. "So that's it... this is the true method to break the ancient chess game."

dialogue.content: "The Twin Stars... must abandon their obsessions simultaneously." Chen Ji's voice trembled with shock, "Not sacrifice, not confrontation, but... together becoming the Dao itself. At that time, the Heavenly Dao's Eye will lose its chessboard, and we will all gain true freedom."

text.content: "But what is the price?" Chen Ji pressed. The visions within the fusion gave the answer—they and Chen Nian would no longer exist as independent beings, but融入天道循环之中. "In other words... I will completely disappear." This recognition made his heart tighten sharply.

At this moment, a violent fluctuation came from the depths of the universe. The Heavenly Dao's Eye detected the anomaly, its consciousness crushing down like Mount Tai. "Found you." That transcendent voice was ice-cold and piercing, "Another ant attempting to jump out of the chessboard."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's figure manifested in the void, his voice ringing simultaneously: "Chen Ji, do you think seeing the truth can change anything? Cang Yutian saw more than you did ten thousand years ago, and in the end, didn't he also choose sealing?" The old sect master's tone dripped with mockery, "Fate was long since determined, you are merely struggling in vain."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's consciousness is locking onto your position, the Twin Fusion state cannot be maintained much longer. You must make a choice—

choices.description: Since this is the only way to break the chess game, let me become the first person to step out of the chessboard. Even if I disappear, I must fight for freedom for Chen Nian and everyone.
choices.visible_reward: Completely break the ancient chess game
choices.risk_hint: This means eternal annihilation, and Chen Nian may not agree

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, supported by the fusion's power, he could see his body gradually becoming transparent. "Chen Nian... I'm sorry." He whispered in his heart, "But this is the only way." He actively guided the fusion's power to charge toward the core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

choices.description: Can the Fourth Ending only have this possibility? Chen Ji's strategic mind does not allow him to accept any "only" answer. He must find a sliver of hope in the desperate situation.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.risk_hint: Time is running out, may miss the best opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji endured the soul-tearing agony, frantically operating the residual power of the Tianji Record Fragment. "The Fourth Ending requires the Twin Stars to abandon their obsessions... but what if my obsession is not 'existence', but 'protection'?" A bold idea took shape in his mind.

choices.description: I've been scheming across the world for so long, not to become a character in someone else's script. Even if the Heavenly Dao's Eye is the final BOSS, I will defeat it my way!
choices.visible_cost: Trigger the Heavenly Dao's Eye's direct attack
choices.visible_reward: Force out more of the enemy's hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: May anger the final BOSS, leading to worsening situation

text.content: "Damn fate!" Chen Ji abruptly severed the connection with the fusion power, the violent backlash causing blood to flow from his seven orifices. But his eyes were clearer than ever—"I've been scheming across the world for so long, just for the day I could personally overturn this chessboard!"

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's core position was completely locked during the fusion. That was a massive eyeball suspended in the depths of the universe's origin, its pupil reflecting the rise and fall of countless realms. "Found it..." Chen Ji's heart surged with joy, "This is your true form!"

At the same time, Chen Ji felt a familiar aura approaching from the distance. It was his missing sister—Chen Nian! Her consciousness had actually resonated with his at this moment. "Brother... I sensed you." Chen Nian's voice rang in his mind, "Whatever choice you make, I'm here."

dialogue.content: "Niannian!" Warmth surged in Chen Ji's heart, but he then hardened his heart—she couldn't let his sister get involved in this chess game destined for sacrifice. "You shouldn't be here. Leave quickly!"

text.content: However, Chen Nian's consciousness firmly linked with his: "I was taken away all these years to become your 'Heavenly Fate Key'. Since the Tianji Record needs a key, then I am that key. Brother, let me help you." Chen Ji felt his eyes moisten—this silly sister, she had tied her fate to his.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's consciousness is with you, and her addition has created new changes in the fusion. You must decide how to handle this sudden power—

choices.text: Share the burden with Chen Nian together
choices.description: Since Niannian is already here, let us siblings fight side by side! Even if we must sacrifice, it will be together, never letting her bear it alone.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian falls into danger together

text.content: Chen Ji no longer resisted, but actively took Chen Nian's consciousness. The two souls embraced tightly in the chaos, and the complete Twin Stars power finally erupted. At that moment, they saw countless timelines—each leading to a different ending.

choices.description: Cannot let Niannian walk my path. Even if sacrificing, only sacrifice me alone. Her future should be beyond the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Chen Nian, making her the final variable
choices.risk_hint: Face the Heavenly Dao's Eye alone, extremely low chance of victory

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly pushed Chen Nian's consciousness out of the fusion range, using his body to shield her from the Heavenly Dao's Eye. "Live, Niannian." He silently recited in his heart, "Brother will buy you time."

The explosion of Fusion Light startled all beings observing this chess game. Ye Qing, far away in the Demonic Path Holy Sect, abruptly stood up, her eyes reflecting that light piercing through the chaos: "This is... Twin Stars power? Chen Ji, what exactly are you doing!" Her voice carried shock and... a hint of anticipation.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression finally changed dramatically. Watching that light tearing through the Heavenly Dao's Eye's outer barrier, he howled: "Impossible! How does he possess complete Twin Stars power? Cang Yutian clearly already..." Before he finished, he realized his loss of composure, quickly restoring his icy-cold expression, "In the end, just a clown, how could a mortal shake the Heavenly Dao's Eye?"

text.content: However, Ling Yuan's calculations were in vain. The world Chen Ji saw after the fusion was completely different—he not only saw the Heavenly Dao's Eye's core, but also the hidden connection between Ling Yuan and the Heavenly Dao's Eye. "So that's it... old sect master, you're not merely a chosen candidate, you are fundamentally a piece of the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

choice.prompt: You have seen through Ling Yuan's hidden cards. Now, you can choose how to use this information—

choices.text: Publicly expose Ling Yuan's true colors
choices.description: Let everyone know this old sect master's true face, making his reputation collapse overnight. The best face-slap is making the enemy suffer social death.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the advantage of secretly targeting Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's reputation destroyed, Tianqing Sect thrown into chaos
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may resort to desperate measures

text.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed in the chaos: "Ling Yuan, the connection between you and the Heavenly Dao's Eye was seen by everyone present. You talk about doing everything for Tianqing Sect, but in reality, you merely want to use Heavenly Dao's power to sit in the sect master's seat forever. How laughable!"

choices.description: Exposing him now is too early, better to keep it as a trump card for later. Let him think he's well hidden, until the critical moment for a killing blow.
choices.visible_cost: Watch Ling Yuan continue his performance helplessly
choices.visible_reward: Gain a fatal strike opportunity in the future
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may detect your abnormality

text.content: Chen Ji buried this discovery deep in his heart, even wearing a dazed expression typical of a "waste". Seeing this, Ling Yuan slightly relaxed—he thought Chen Ji was merely bluffing. But what he didn't see was the icy killing intent that flashed in Chen Ji's eyes.

The fusion's time was about to run out. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's consciousness frantically counterattacked, attempting to regain control of the chess game. But Chen Ji had already obtained what he needed—the complete path to the Fourth Ending, and an unprecedented discovery: within the Heavenly Dao's Eye's core, a strand of Cang Yutian's remnant soul was sealed!

dialogue.content: "Senior... so you never truly perished." Chen Ji轻声说道in his consciousness. Cang Yutian's remnant soul trembled slightly, transmitting a trace of bitter laughter: "Kid, you've walked further than I imagined. Now, you know what to do, right?"

text.content: The moment the fusion completely dissipated, Chen Ji fell back into his own body. Intense weakness struck him, but unprecedented light burned in his eyes. The Fourth Ending—the true freedom without anyone having to sacrifice, lay before him. And in his hand, he already held the key to open that door.

Ye Qing in the distant demonic army showed a shaken expression for the first time. She gazed at the fading light in the direction of Tianqing Sect, murmuring softly: "Chen Ji... perhaps you're right, there is another possibility in this world." She slowly withdrew the command flag pointing toward Tianqing Sect, "Pass the order, the army stands by—do not attack for now." This was the first time the demonic path commander-in-chief showed hesitation toward Tianqing Sect.

Ling Yuan's expression was gloomy enough to drip water. He never expected Chen Ji to not only disrupt the Heavenly Dao's Eye's plans but also accidentally expose his connection to it. Although most people hadn't reacted yet, several scrutinizing gazes within Tianqing Sect had already fallen on him. "Chen Ji... wait for me." The old sect master's fists clenched tightly, his fingernails deeply embedded in his palms.
